ideas.pitch: An autonomous governance agent that audits student GitHub submissions against 3SVK research submission guidelines, automatically generating evaluation pull requests and verifying document lineages.
ideas.title: 3SVK Cloud-Native Student Research Audit Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the official execution workflow of the 3SVK organizers who are actively processing 4,000+ GitHub pull requests and project submissions.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router that classifies incoming student research papers and code repositories into appropriate evaluation tracks using kNN exemplar indexes over Qwen embeddings.
ideas.title: Semantic Research Router for 3SVK Submissions
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact winning architecture of top semantic routing hacks by solving high-volume categorization tasks for judges.

ideas.pitch: An automated data lineage and incident response tool that tracks student cloud resource usage during research challenges and generates verifiable repair PRs upon configuration drift.
ideas.title: Autonomous Data Lineage for Student Cloud Labs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages complex data engineering patterns that impress technical reviewers conducting deep code audits.

ideas.pitch: An edge-optimized code review utility running on local hardware NPUs that audits student submissions for security vulnerabilities and style violations without relying on external cloud APIs.
ideas.title: Offline NPU-Accelerated Code Reviewer for Student Repos
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on hard engineering constraints and offline local execution, standing out among standard cloud-wrapper projects.

ideas.pitch: Two identical AI reviewer agents that debate the validity and novelty of submitted student research papers to catch inconsistencies and hallucinated citations before human audit.
ideas.title: Adversarial Peer Review Simulator for Student Research
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced multi-agent self-improving dynamics and adversarial evaluation that immediately captivates general judges.
